0022600008.text: Boston hosts New York in its second game of the 2026-27 season, after losing its opener on the road, and the Celtics sit at 0-1, 12th in the East and 1.5 games behind fifth place in the Atlantic. The Knicks are also 0-1 after losing their opener at home, ranking ninth in the East and 1.5 games back of third in the Atlantic, and the teams have not met yet this season, though Boston lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, and the teams' last meeting was an April 9, 2026 regular-season game in New York that the Celtics lost 112-106.
